## Example 7.9 · (c–d) {#iv7-example-7-9-cd .vector-lesson .projection-lesson }

```{=html}
<p>The point <span data-math="P"></span> has coordinates <span data-math="(1,3)"></span> and the line <span data-math="\ell"></span> has Cartesian equation <span data-math="y=\tfrac12 x"></span>. Let <span data-math="O"></span> be the origin and let <span data-math="H"></span> be the foot of the perpendicular from <span data-math="P"></span> to <span data-math="\ell"></span>.</p><div class="pr-cols"><div><p>c) Find <span data-math="\overrightarrow{HP}"></span>.</p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="pr-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \overrightarrow{HP}=\overrightarrow{OP}-\overrightarrow{OH}"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle =(1,3)-(2,1)=(-1,2)"></span></div><p>Check: <span data-math="(-1)(2)+2(1)=0"></span>.</p></div></div></div><div><p>d) Hence calculate the shortest distance from <span data-math="P"></span> to <span data-math="\ell"></span>.</p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="pr-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle d=|\overrightarrow{HP}|"></span></div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle =\sqrt{(-1)^2+2^2}=\sqrt5"></span></div></div></div></div></div>
```
